walk: Create a clean production animation sprite sheet using BOTH references. Image1 is the exact character design: Nery Mizuki, copper-haired amber-eyed chibi girl, cream bows, open charcoal zip hoodie with terracotta piping, cream shirt, dark shorts, dark socks, orange/brown sneakers with cream soles. Image2 is the mandatory sixteen-pose WALKING GUIDE, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Reproduce the LEG POSE of EACH corresponding guide cell precisely, with the near and far leg kept distinct, replacing the stick figure with the fully rendered character from image1. Keep her full detailed anime chibi style, same face, head size, costume and proportions throughout. ALL sixteen figures face LEFT. EXACTLY four columns and four rows. Keep a single body scale, head anchor, floor baseline and fixed cell grid throughout. One sole planted at every step. Two legs only, anatomically coherent knees, natural small arm counterswing. First eight frames advance one step, next eight the opposite step: no repeated same foot shuffle. No labels, numbers, words, captions, arrows, guide lines, shadows, props or background. Genuine transparent background with clean alpha edges. Leave empty padding around each drawing. Do not draw the stickfigure guide or its colors. Only the finished sixteen character cels.
cleanup: Edit this animation sprite sheet. Remove EVERY label, number, caption, arrow, grid line, ground shadow and annotation completely. Keep only the twelve character drawings and their props, on a genuinely transparent background. Arrange the SAME twelve character drawings in their original reading order into EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, generous margins, perfectly aligned cell centers and a shared floor baseline, same scale in every cell. Preserve the character, all twelve poses, face, outfit, anatomy and animation sequence. Do not add anything. No text, no marks, no background. Each drawing must fit entirely inside its own cell. Clean anti-aliased silhouette.
note: Final walk uses the canonical full-body reference plus walk-pose-guide.png. Cleanup edits apply to failed, waiting, working and review source sheets; the final output grid is four columns by three rows.
